description.value: Kaffina Coffee is a community-oriented neighbourhood café on King George Boulevard in Surrey, focused on quality espresso drinks, cold brews, specialty teas, and freshly made sandwiches. The shop emphasizes a cozy, welcoming atmosphere and has outdoor seating in a pedestrian zone. It offers both in-person and online ordering, making it a convenient stop for those wanting a quick bite or a sit-down coffee break.
